neighbours.label: the pro-form in an 'as X is/does (in Y)' comparison clause (as they do here, as it is in Germany, as was the case)
fire: Prices there are not nearly as high as they are in London.
We don't tip waiters the way they do in the United States.
Just as it was in the last election, turnout was very low.
The winters are not as harsh as they are further north.
Children in Finland start school later than they do in Britain.
As is the case with most vaccines, mild side effects are common.
The law is not enforced as strictly as it is in Singapore.
They celebrate the holiday with fireworks, as we do at home.
quiet: Prices there have risen sharply over the last two years.
We usually leave a small tip for the waiters after dinner.
Turnout in the last election was very low across the country.
The winters further north are long, dark and very cold.
Children in Finland start school at the age of seven.
Mild side effects such as a sore arm are common with vaccines.
The law in Singapore is enforced strictly by the police.
They celebrate the holiday with fireworks and a big dinner.
